say:1:1034128001:1.text: Much better after taking the medicine sent by the village elder.
say:1:1034128001:1.source_cn: 吃过村长发下来的草药后我就痊愈了。
say:1:1034128001:1.male: Much better after taking the medicine sent by the village elder.
say:1:1034128001:1.female: Much better after taking the medicine sent by the village elder.

say:2:1034128002:1.text: Thanks to your help, our village has returned to normal.
say:2:1034128002:1.source_cn: 在你们的援助下，我们的村子已经恢复正常。
say:2:1034128002:1.male: Thanks to your help, our village has returned to normal.
say:2:1034128002:1.female: Thanks to your help, our village has returned to normal.

say:3:1034128003:1.text: You know what? When I heard Taran's Spring was contaminated, I worried whether or not I would ever taste its crisp, clean flavor again.
say:3:1034128003:1.source_cn: 你知道吗？当我听说塔兰之源被污染之后，我一直担心自己还...
say:3:1034128003:1.male: You know what? When I heard Taran's Spring was contaminated, I worried whether or not I would ever taste its crisp, clean flavor again.
say:3:1034128003:1.female: You know what? When I heard Taran's Spring was contaminated, I worried whether or not I would ever taste its crisp, clean flavor again.

say:4:1034128004:1.text: Thank the Deer Spirit that you were finally able to set things right.
say:4:1034128004:1.source_cn: 鹿灵保佑，这一切终于被你们阻止。
say:4:1034128004:1.male: Thank the Deer Spirit that you were finally able to set things right.
say:4:1034128004:1.female: Thank the Deer Spirit that you were finally able to set things right.
